dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Jalalabad City, Nangarhar Province as of 2 September 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20250901AFG, GDACS ID: 1498339** This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by the August 31, 2025, earthquake in Afghanistan. The analysis focuses on Jalalabad City and surrounding area, Nangarhar Province, where damage was detected using a Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on September 2, 2025. UNOSAT identified 12 damaged building and 69 potentially damaged buildings. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Ground verification is encouraged, and feedback can be sent to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
